appDownload.title: Albamount on your phone
appDownload.lead: The same catalog in an app-like experience: services, account, languages, and admin.
appDownload.step1: Open this page on your Android phone and tap Download APK.
appDownload.step2: Allow install from this source if Android asks.
appDownload.step3: Open the file and install Albamount.
appDownload.androidLead: Install the APK — like a regular app with its own icon.
appDownload.iosLead: Apple does not allow free APK-style installs. On iPhone, add Albamount to the Home Screen — it opens like an app with the Albamount icon.
appDownload.iosStep2: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow up).
appDownload.iosStep4: Tap Add — the Albamount icon appears on the Home Screen.
appDownload.iosNote: Use Safari. After adding, open Albamount from the Home Screen icon.

intro.title: A catalog, not a feed
intro.text: Services and buy/sell in one place. Browse cards or publish your own — without noise and endless scrolling.
intro.step1: Each card shows the essentials: photos, video, price, and the author's contacts.
intro.step2: The i icon opens the description. Chat on the card — message the author without leaving the page.
intro.step3: Create your listing in your account; it appears in the catalog after publishing.

rules.title: Publication rules
rules.intro: By publishing a card on Albamount you confirm that you have read these rules and are fully responsible for texts, photos, videos, links, and contacts. A violation may lead to rejection or blocking of the card, and in case of repeated or serious violations — to blocking of the account.
rules.allowed1: Honest Buy/Sell listings and descriptions of real services.
rules.allowed2: Your own photos and videos, or materials you have the right to use.
rules.allowed3: Up-to-date contact details for buyers or clients.
rules.forbiddenLead: You must not publish any materials that:
rules.forbiddenRights: infringe the rights of other people or organizations: someone else’s photos or videos without permission, trademarks and brands you do not have the right to use, personal data, defamation, insults;
rules.forbiddenTobacco: advertise tobacco, nicotine, e-cigarettes, vapes, or smoking mixtures;
rules.forbiddenIndecent: contain indecent, pornographic, or erotic content, violence, or hate speech;
rules.forbiddenOther: involve fraud, prohibited goods or services, or attempts to bypass moderation.
rules.consequences: The administration may reject a card, take it down, or block it without prior notice. Serious or repeated violations may result in account blocking. If a paid card is rejected while still pending, ALBA is returned; published or blocked cards are not refunded.
rules.lifetimeFree: A free card stays in the catalog for 7 days after moderator approval, then it is unpublished.
rules.lifetimePaid: A card published with ALBA stays in the catalog for 1 month. If you allowed auto-debit and have 30 ALBA, the term extends automatically. Otherwise renewal is another payment and a new publication.
rules.lifetimeEdit: You may edit an approved card for free within 24 hours. After that, changes are only possible by creating a new card.
rules.responsibility: You guarantee that your content is lawful. Albamount does not review every card for every possible violation and may remove material after a complaint or a moderator decision.
rules.contact: If a card was rejected or blocked by mistake, contact us through the “Contact us” form.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Albamount (“we”) processes personal data when you use www.albamount.xyz and the Albamount Android application (a secure browser shell for the same service).
privacy.whoBody: Controller: Albamount. Contact: support@albamount.xyz or the Contact form on the site.
privacy.dataAccount: Account data: nickname, email, password hash, account type, verification status, ALBA balance and related history.
privacy.dataContent: User content: listings (text, contacts, photos, optional video/link), comments/chat on cards, votes.
privacy.dataTech: Technical data: cookies/session (including authentication JWT), language preference, guest identifier for voting, approximate device/browser info needed to run the site and app.
privacy.dataMessages: Messages you send via Contact us (name, email, subject, text).
privacy.whyBody: To provide the catalog and accounts, moderate listings, prevent abuse, send verification and password-reset emails, improve reliability and security, and respond to support requests. Legal bases include contract performance and legitimate interests in operating a safe marketplace.
privacy.shareBody: We use infrastructure providers (hosting/database), email delivery (SMTP), and Cloudinary for image hosting. We do not sell your personal data. Data may be disclosed if required by law.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep account and content data while your account is active. After you delete your account, we permanently remove the account and associated content we control (including listings, photos we host, comments, and related records), except where we must retain limited records for legal or security reasons.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on your region, you may request access, correction, or deletion. In the app/site you can delete your account in My account (password + confirmation). You can also contact support@albamount.xyz. Password reset is available only for verified emails.
privacy.childrenBody: The service is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). Do not create an account if you are under that age.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about privacy: support@albamount.xyz or https://www.albamount.xyz/contacts

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Albamount (website and Android app) you agree to these Terms.
terms.serviceBody: Albamount is an online catalog for services and buy/sell listings. Features may change as we improve the product.
terms.accountBody: You must provide accurate information, keep your password secure, and use only one account unless we allow otherwise. You may delete your account in My account; deletion removes your account and related content as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.contentBody: You are responsible for listings, photos, contacts, and messages you publish. You grant us a license to host and display that content to operate the catalog. Do not post illegal, infringing, or harmful material.
terms.rulesBody: Listings must follow the Publication Rules: https://www.albamount.xyz/rules. We may reject, hide, or remove content and suspend accounts that violate the rules.
terms.appBody: The Android app displays the Albamount website in a dedicated shell. The same Terms and Privacy Policy apply. Sideloaded APK builds outside Google Play are provided at your own risk until a Play listing is available.
terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided “as is”. We are not a party to deals between users. To the fullest extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect losses arising from use of the catalog.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms. The date above shows the latest revision.
